description:
Import a phone number associated with a SIP trunk.
(Tags: Phone numbers)

name.description: Optional friendly name for the imported number.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format (starting with `+`).

sip_dial_prefix.description: Optional prefix to prepend before the destination number when dialing (e.g. to strip the country code).

sip_strip_plus.description: When true, strips the leading `+` from the dialed number.

sip_trunk_name.description: Name for this SIP trunk (must be unique within your account).

name: importSipTrunk
